description: This file defines data structures, constants, and methods related to access control policies in the Mattermost server, including validation, inheritance, and auditing of policies.

classes.name: AccessControlAttribute
classes.description: Represents a user attribute with its name and possible values.

classes.name: AccessControlPolicyTestResponse
classes.description: Response structure for testing access control policies, including users and total count.

classes.name: GetAccessControlPolicyOptions
classes.description: Options for retrieving access control policies, including type, parent ID, cursor, and limit.

classes.name: AccessControlPolicySearch
classes.description: Structure for searching access control policies with filters like term, type, parent ID, and activity status.

classes.name: AccessControlPolicyCursor
classes.description: Cursor for paginating access control policies, with validation and emptiness checks.

classes.name: AccessControlPoliciesWithCount
classes.description: Holds a list of policies with total count.

classes.name: AccessControlPolicy
classes.description: Main structure representing an access control policy, including validation, inheritance, and auditing methods.

classes.name: AccessControlPolicyRule
classes.description: Defines actions and expressions for a policy rule.

classes.name: CELExpressionError
classes.description: Represents errors in CEL expressions with line, column, and message.

classes.name: AccessControlQueryResult
classes.description: Result of a query matching subject IDs.

classes.name: AccessControlPolicyActiveUpdate
classes.description: Represents an update to a policy's active status.

classes.name: AccessControlPolicyActiveUpdateRequest
classes.description: Request structure for updating multiple policies' active statuses.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns audit information for a policy or update request.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the policy based on its version and type.

methods.name: accessPolicyVersionV0_1
methods.description: Validation logic specific to version v0.1 of policies.

methods.name: accessPolicyVersionV0_2
methods.description: Validation logic specific to version v0.2 of policies.

methods.name: Inherit
methods.description: Inherits rules and imports from a parent policy.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the cursor is empty.
